#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;

const double EPS = 1e-15;

pii reduce_fraction(int a, int b) {
    int g = __gcd(a, b);
    return {a / g, b / g};
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    double x, y, n_double;
    cin >> x >> y >> n_double;
    int n = static_cast<int>(n_double);
    
    double ratio = x / y;
    pii best = {0, 1};
    double min_diff = numeric_limits<double>::max();
    
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        double scaled = ratio * i;
        int floor_val = static_cast<int>(floor(scaled + EPS));
        int ceil_val = static_cast<int>(ceil(scaled - EPS));
        
        auto try_candidate = [&](int num, int den) {
            double approx = static_cast<double>(num) / den;
            double diff = fabs(ratio - approx);
            if (diff < min_diff - EPS || (fabs(diff - min_diff) < EPS && den < best.second)) {
                min_diff = diff;
                best = {num, den};
            }
        };
        
        try_candidate(floor_val, i);
        try_candidate(ceil_val, i);
    }
    
    pii reduced = reduce_fraction(best.first, best.second);
    cout << reduced.first << "/" << reduced.second << "\n";
    
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <limits>
#include <utility>
#include <iomanip>

using namespace std;

using pii = pair<int, int>;

inline int gcd(int a, int b) {
    while (b != 0) {
        int t = b;
        b = a % b;
        a = t;
    }
    return a;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    double x, y, n;
    cin >> x >> y >> n;
    
    double target = x / y;
    pii best = {0, 1};
    double best_diff = numeric_limits<double>::max();
    
    for (int i = 1; i <= static_cast<int>(n); ++i) {
        double val = target * i;
        int candidates[2] = {static_cast<int>(floor(val + 1e-15)), static_cast<int>(ceil(val - 1e-15))};
        
        for (int j = 0; j < 2; ++j) {
            int num = candidates[j];
            if (num < 0) continue;
            
            double approx = static_cast<double>(num) / i;
            double diff = fabs(target - approx);
            
            if (diff < best_diff - 1e-15 || (diff < best_diff + 1e-15 && diff > best_diff - 1e-15 && i < best.second)) {
                best_diff = diff;
                best = {num, i};
            }
        }
    }
    
    int g = gcd(best.first, best.second);
    cout << best.first / g << "/" << best.second / g;
    
    return 0;
}
